timezone_note: PKT is UTC+5 year-round - Pakistan observes no daylight saving, so the UTC offset never moves and cron needs no seasonal correction.
jitter_note: Each slot is nudged by a deterministic +/- offset seeded from the post id. Deterministic so re-running the builder never reshuffles an already-published queue, and jittered so five posts a day do not land on the same clock minute forever - an exactly periodic pattern is one of the cheaper things for spam heuristics to spot.

dk.name: DK Lighting

slot_rationale.11:30: Late-morning desk lull. Trade buyers - electricians, dealers, contractors - are reachable between site visits, and this is the slot the wholesale-angled posts are aimed at.
slot_rationale.20:30: After dinner, the strongest consumer window in Pakistan. Home and decor buying intent peaks here, which suits the room-application and energy-saving posts.

dk.order_note: Round-robin across product groups so the six 15W panel variants never land on consecutive days. Nothing in DK's set is date-sensitive.

wegraphers.name: Wegraphers

slot_rationale.13:00: Lunch break scroll. Reels traffic is non-follower traffic, and midday is when it is cheapest to earn.
slot_rationale.18:30: Commute and early evening - the day's first long scroll session.
slot_rationale.21:45: Late-evening peak. Highest watch-through of the three, so the strongest films should land here.

wegraphers.order_note: Strict post_no order, and it must stay that way. The file numbering (01=H3, 02=H2, 03=H1 ...) encodes the grid layout described in CAPTIONS.md: Instagram fills newest-first from the top left, so posting the right-hand tile of each row first is what makes the finished profile grid read left-to-right. Re-sorting this list scrambles the grid.

25.reason: A4 is the Azadi Sale promo, cut for 14 August. In strict post order it would fall around 21 August - a week after Independence Day, advertising a sale that has ended. Pinned to the day itself.

tokens._comment: DK's captions end on a WhatsApp call to action and carry a {{WHATSAPP}} placeholder. Set the number here in full international form, e.g. +92 300 1234567. The publisher refuses to post a caption with an unresolved placeholder rather than publishing '{{WHATSAPP}}' to 8.7k followers.
